Resolutions of 1989

20 resolutions, 90% unanimous. Thaw and boom.

  • 627 (1989) Election of members of the International Court of Justice

  • 629 (1989) Settlement of the Namibia question
  • 630 (1989) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 631 (1989) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Iran-Iraq Military Observer Group
  • 632 (1989) Implementation of the UN Plan for the Independence of Namibia
  • 633 (1989) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 634 (1989) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
  • 635 (1989) Marking of plastic or sheet explosives for the purpose of detection
  • 636 (1989) Deportation of 8 Palestinian civilians by Israel from the occupied territories
  • 637 (1989) The Guatemala Agreement of 1987
  • 638 (1989) Incidents of hostage-taking and abduction
  • 639 (1989) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon
  • 640 (1989) The electoral process in Namibia
  • 641 (1989) Deportation of Palestinian civilians by Israel from the occupied territories
  • 642 (1989) Extension of the mandate of the UN Iran-Iraq Military Observer Group
  • 643 (1989) The holding of free and fair elections in Namibia
  • 644 (1989) Establishment of the UN Observer Group in Central America
  • 645 (1989) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force
  • 646 (1989) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peace-keeping Force in Cyprus
